GenAiFunction.description: Use this when a law-firm website visitor asks what the firm does, which areas of law it handles, or for help finding the right practice area — for example "what kind of cases do you take?", "I was in a car accident", "do you handle divorce?", or "how can you help me?". Shows an expandable "How can we help?" practice-area guide; each area opens to reveal a description, common matter types, a trust stat, and a display-only link, plus a Get-help action per area.
GenAiFunction.progressIndicatorMessage: Pulling up how we can help
